summary: New indicator ids from the whistleblowing indicator review (decision 11).

new_indicators.name: Awards share
new_indicators.definition: Percentage of a programme's awards (measure=count), award money (measure=amount), award recipients (measure=recipients) or respondents in award cases (measure=respondents), in a period or to date, that have one feature (legal basis, reduced for delay, anonymous tip, reported internally first, foreign, individuals); breakdown item= or subsection= names the feature. Printed by the source, never calculated by us.

new_indicators.name: Protection share
new_indicators.definition: Percentage of whistleblower protection requests (default) or protected statuses granted (stage=status_granted) that have one outcome or feature: acceptance rate (outcome=acceptance_rate), granting body (granted_by=). Printed by the source.

new_indicators.name: On-time share
new_indicators.definition: Percentage of claims processed, or notices to whistleblowers issued, within a statutory or internal time limit in a period; breakdown item= names the step or notice (stat=timely). Printed by the source.

new_indicators.name: Award size
new_indicators.definition: Size of a single award as printed by the source: the average award per approved application, rewarded case or award (default, or stat=average), or the highest or lowest single award in a period (stat=highest, stat=lowest). Excludes totals paid (awards_paid_amount) and awards as a share of recoveries (award_rate_average).
